name: Sefton Community Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network serving Formby. Emergency food parcels with referral. Open Mon and Thu 10am-2pm. Based at Formby Methodist Church.

name: Sefton Council Allotments
description: Two sites: Altcar Road and Harington Road. Plots from £40/year. Includes water and storage facilities. Waiting lists operate.

name: Formby Community Garden Volunteers
description: Near Formby Hall. Volunteer-run garden with seasonal vegetables and soft fruits. Harvest shared among volunteers and local food banks.
